title: Pacaccini says he saw 35-second video of captive creature
summary: Vitorio Pacaccini tells of Pacaccini says he saw 35-second video of captive creature, about 1996 at Brazil, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: know and I saw with my own eyes an alien creature kept in captivity in this 35 second video.

plain: Vitorio Pacaccini, a UFO researcher in Brazil, says that around 1996 he saw a 35-second military video. He says that with his own eyes he saw in it a creature that was not human, being held captive. If true, it would mean a military had caught a living non-human being and filmed it.
